units.source_text: 他想念桐壶更衣娘家情状，挑尽残灯，终夜枯坐凝思，懒去睡眠。

en.t: He thought of the state of Lady Kiritsubo's family home, trimmed the last of the lamp through the night, and sat alone in weary thought, unwilling to go to sleep.

units.source_text: 听见巡夜的右近卫官唱名[\[21\]](#part1330.html#m21)，知道此刻已经是丑时了。

en.t: Hearing the night patrol officer of the Right Palace Guards call out his name[\[21\]](#part1330.html#m21), he knew that it was already the Hour of the Ox.

units.source_text: 因恐枯坐过久，惹人注目，便起身进内就寝，却难于入寐。

en.t: Afraid that sitting there too long would draw attention, he rose and went inside to lie down, but he could not fall asleep.

units.source_text: 翌日晨起，回想从前“珠帘锦帐不觉晓”[\[22\]](#part1330.html#m22)之情景，不胜悲戚，就懒得处理朝政了。

en.t: When he rose the next morning, he remembered the former days when behind jeweled curtains and brocade bed hangings they had not noticed dawn[\[22\]](#part1330.html#m22); overcome with grief, he had no heart to attend to affairs of state.

units.source_text: 皇上饮食不进：早膳勉强举箸，应名而已；正式御餐，久已废止了。

en.t: The Emperor took almost no food: at breakfast he forced himself to lift his chopsticks only for appearance's sake, while formal imperial meals had long since been discontinued.

units.source_text: 凡侍候御膳的人，看到这光景，无不忧愁叹息。

en.t: Everyone who served the imperial meals saw this and could not help grieving and sighing.

units.source_text: 所有近身侍臣，不论男女，都很焦急，叹道：“这真是毫无办法了！”

en.t: All the close attendants, men and women alike, were deeply anxious and sighed, "There is truly nothing that can be done!"

units.source_text: 他们私下议论：“皇上和这桐壶更衣，定有前世宿缘。

en.t: In private they said, "The Emperor and this Lady Kiritsubo must surely have been bound by karma from a former life.

units.source_text: 更衣在世之时，万人讥诮怨恨，皇上一概置之不顾。

en.t: When the Lady was alive, everyone mocked and resented her, yet the Emperor paid no heed to any of it.

units.source_text: 凡有关这更衣之事，一味徇情不讲道理。

en.t: In every matter concerning this Lady, he simply yielded to feeling and ignored all reason.

units.source_text: 如今更衣已死，又是日日愁叹，不理朝政。

en.t: Now that she is dead, he spends each day grieving and sighing, neglecting the government.
This is truly far too unreasonable!"

units.source_text: 他们又引证出唐玄宗等外国朝廷的例子来，低声议论，悄悄地叹息。

en.t: They also cited examples from foreign courts, such as Emperor Xuanzong of Tang, discussing them in low voices and sighing in secret.
